description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Vikings signed Jamal Adams.
items.impact: Adams has struggled to stay healthy in recent years. He lands a fresh start in Minnesota under Brian Flores.
items.title: Jamal Adams signs with Vikings

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Seahawks plan to waive RB Kenny McIntosh.
items.impact: McIntosh began training camp on PUP while recovering from a torn ACL he suffered last summer. He has struggled with injuries since being drafted in 2023.
items.title: Kenny McIntosh to be waived by Seahawks

items.author: Diego Sandoval
items.desc: Vita Vea has requested a trade from the Tampa Bay Buccaneers.
items.impact: Vea was a minicamp hold-in and is entering the final year of his contract, in which he is owed $17 million. The defensive tackle requesting a trade does not guarantee he will be on a new team by Week 1, but this is definitely a situation to monitor as training camp kicks off around the league this week.
items.title: Vita Vea requests trade from Buccaneers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Dolphins released DL Kahlil Saunders.
items.impact: Saunders will figure to seek another opportunity entering training camp.
items.title: Kahlil Saunders released by Dolphins

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Miami Dolphins have signed EDGE Clelin Ferrell.
items.impact: Ferrell is a former No. 4 overall pick of the Raiders. He'll add depth for the pass rush of Miami.
items.title: Clelin Ferrell signs with Dolphins

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Chargers released OL Ben Cleveland.
items.impact: Cleveland has appeared in 64 regular season games and five postseason game for the Ravens over his five seasons with the team. He'll figure to seek another opportunity heading into training camp.
items.title: Ben Cleveland released by Chargers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Raiders hosted WR KJ Hamler for a workout.
items.impact: Hamler last appeared in a regular season game for the Broncos in 2022.
items.title: KJ Hamler works out for Raiders

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Vikings placed RB Kejon Owens on the non-football injury list.
items.impact: Owens signed with Minnesota as an undrafted free agent. He can be activated at any point during training camp.
items.title: Kejon Owens placed on NFI list

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Vikings waived WR Luke Wysong.
items.impact: Wysong will figure to seek another opportunity heading into training camp.
items.title: Luke Wysong waived by Vikings

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Vikings waived LB Keli Lawson.
items.impact: Lawson will figure to seek another opportunity heading into training camp.
items.title: Keli Lawson waived by Vikings

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Rams signed OL Bill Murray.
items.impact: Murray has appeared in four regular season games. He will compete for a depth role on the Rams offensive line.
items.title: Bill Murray signs with Rams

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Rams signed DB Alex Cook.
items.impact: Cook has appeared in 10 career games with two starts. He'll compete for a depth role in the Rams secondary.
items.title: Alex Cook signs with Rams

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Giants hosted LB Kenneth Murray Jr. for a workout on Monday.
items.impact: Murray started 16 games for the Cowboys last season where he registered 81 tackles. He has not reached a deal yet.
items.title: Kenneth Murray Jr. works out for Giants Monday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Giants signed TE Tyler Murray.
items.impact: The former Iowa State TE was an undrafted free agent. He will compete for a depth role in the Giants tight end room.
items.title: Tyler Murray signs with Giants

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Rams hosted OL Tyler McLellan for a workout on Monday.
items.impact: McLellan was most recently with the Buccaneers in a depth role.
items.title: Tyler McLellan works out for Rams

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Packers hosted RB Jermar Jefferson for a workout on Monday.
items.impact: Jefferson will remain off the fantasy radar.
items.title: Jermar Jefferson works out for Packers Monday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Giants hosted Eric McAlister for a work out.
items.impact: McAlister passed his physical after he broke a bone in his foot during his Pro Day.  He was expected to be selected on Day 3 of the NFL Draft prior to his injury.
items.title: Eric McAlister works out for Giants

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Packers are expected to place Micah Parsons on the PUP list on Tuesday or Wednesday.
items.impact: Parsons is expected to miss the start of the season. He is targeting his return in October.
items.title: Micah Parsons (knee) will be placed on PUP list

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Jaguars hosted free agent WR Zay Jones for a visit on Monday.
items.impact: Jones has appeared in 19 games the last two seasons with Arizona. He is likely to remain off the fantasy radar.
items.title: Zay Jones visits Jaguars Monday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Packers placed RB Chris Brooks on the non-football injury list.
items.impact: Brooks can be activated at any point during training camp.
items.title: Chris Brooks placed on NFI list

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Packers placed CB Kamal Hadden on the PUP list.
items.impact: Hadden will not be ready to go to begin training camp. He can be activated at any point during camp.
items.title: Kamal Hadden placed on PUP list

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Packers placed DT Javon Hargrave on the PUP list.
items.impact: Hargrave will not be ready to go to begin training camp. He can be activated at any point during camp.
items.title: Javon Hargrave placed on PUP list

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Packers placed OL Aaron Banks on the PUP list.
items.impact: Banks will not be ready to go for the start of training camp. He can be activated at any time.
items.title: Aaron Banks placed on PUP list

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Packers placed TE Luke Musgrave on the PUP list.
items.impact: Musgrave is not ready to go for the start of training camp. He can be activated at any point.
items.title: Luke Musgrave placed on PUP list

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Packers placed TE Tucker Kraft on the PUP list.
items.impact: Kraft is recovering from a torn ACL that ended his 2025 season. He is still currently on track to be ready for Week 1.
items.title: Tucker Kraft (knee) placed on PUP list
